name: Mridangam Misra Chapu 7
desc: Mridangam theka in Misra Chapu tala, a lop-sided 7-beat cycle grouped 3+2+2. Accented sam alternates thom/dhum, a nam-dhin answer with 7-step ghost gains, a ki euclid (4,7) that rotates, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, lastOf(4) doubling fills and an iter(7) that walks the seven-beat pattern one aksharam per cycle, realigning every seven bars.

code.full: stack(s("<mridangam_thom mridangam_dhum> mridangam_ki mridangam_tha mridangam_thom mridangam_ta mridangam_thom mridangam_ki").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.25).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}*1.15).slow(28)), s("mridangam_nam mridangam_ki mridangam_dhin mridangam_ki mridangam_nam mridangam_ta mridangam_dhin").gain(".5 .26 .44 .24 .46 .24 .4").shape(.2).pan(sine.range(.45,.55).slow(20)), s("mridangam_ki(4,7,<0 2 4>)").gain(.2).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(14))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<mridangam_thom mridangam_dhum> mridangam_ki mridangam_ta mridangam_tha mridangam_thom mridangam_ki mridangam_ta").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.65, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)), s("mridangam_nam mridangam_dhin mridangam_ki mridangam_ta mridangam_nam mridangam_dhin mridangam_ki").gain(".5 .44 .28 .26 .48 .42 .28").shape(.22).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(20)), s("mridangam_gumki(3,7,<0 2 4>)").gain(.3).lastOf(2, x=>x.ply(2)), s("mridangam_ki(5,7,<0 3>)").gain(.22).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(12))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(7).fast(${rate}).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
